50091710.protein: Mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase kinase 4
50091710.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal His-tagged C-terminal Avi-tagged MAP4K4 (unknown origin) expressed in baculovirus expression system by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: MAP4K4-Based Fragment Screen. MAP4K4 (residues 3–328) containing an N-terminal His-tag and a C-terminal Avi-tag (Avidity, LLC) was biotinylated during baculovirus expression and purified to homogeneity by nickel-affinity and size-exclusion chromatography. Mass analysis indicated that there was no phosphorylation of the purified material. For SPR experiments, the biotinylated protein was captured to CMS chips (GE Healthcare) manually coupled with ~8,000 RU of neutravidin (Pierce) inside a Biacore T100 (GE Healthcare) as previously described. After priming into the experimental running buffer (50 mM HEPES, pH 7.2, 150 mM NaCl, 2 mM MgCl2, 1 mM TCEP, 0.01% Tween-20, 1% PEG-3350, and 5% DMSO), 4,000–8,000 RU of MAP4K4 was generally captured. Good long-term binding stability of the surface was observed during pilot fragment screening that included the use of a control compound with a KD of 1 μM and a dissociation half-life of ~3 s. A screen of the Genentech edition one fragment library (~2,500 compounds) was executed using a single-point screen at 100 μM compound. Raw sensorgram data were reduced, solvent corrected, double reference inspected for poor sensorgrams and aggregating compounds, and fit using Scrubber II (BioLogic Software, Campbell, Australia; http://www.biologic.com.au). Primary data were additionally corrected for drift, daily solvent mismatches, and scaled to fractional binding occupancy using BioBook (IDBS) as previously discussed. Approximately 300 hits were further characterized in a dose–response format by SPR at 200 μM in a 2-fold dilution series to yield KD and LE information. A total of 225 hits were characterized and confirmed with a KD range of 10 to 2000 μM and LEs ranging from 0.24 to 0.59 with a median of 0.33.
